items.title: Destiny 1 project, which aims to port the game to PC, seemingly gets a nod from Bungie boss
items.description:
The original Destiny never made it to PC, but the shooter-MMO may not stay locked to PS4 and Xbox One for much longer. Some crafty modders have been working to get the game running on PC, and their efforts recently caught the eye of Bungie, which surprisingly didn't result in a take-down - not yet, at least.

Read more

items.title: "You don't listen to the loudest people in the room" - World of Warcraft: Forever boss discusses how to approach a deluge of feedback
items.description:
World of Warcraft executive producer Holly Longdale has spoken at PAX Australia ahead of World of Warcraft: Forever's imminent release. Of note were her comments on the sheer popularity of the beta and how the team is handling the waves of feedback from early players.

Read more

items.title: Former game-seller Zavvi enters administration again and "is unable to fulfil any outstanding orders or pre-orders"
items.description:
Former game-seller Zavvi could be about to close for good; the company announced it has entered administration and that it has ceased trading while the insolvency process is resolved.

Read more

items.title: Xbox announces what sounds like a generative AI-focused game-making department, Xbox Labs, while avoiding mentioning AI
items.description:
Xbox is reacting - uncharacteristically quickly - to the deluge of vibe-coded game ports, decompiles and recompiles we've been seeing online in recent weeks by establishing Xbox Labs, a new initiative seemingly designed to explore the phenomenon.

Read more

items.title: CD Projekt Red reassures players The Witcher 3 Switch 2 patch still due, as update rolls out for PS5 and PS5 Pro
items.description:
CD Projekt Red has released an update for The Witcher 3 Remastered on PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro, making "various stability improvements to help ensure a more reliable experience" to the game. And those are the entire patch notes for hotfix 5.01b, Eurogamer understands.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past

items.title: "That was not received well at Nintendo" - as GTA 6 and Zelda are lampooned by Saturday Night Live, former employees recall Elon Musk Wario skit controversy
items.description:
As American comedy series Saturday Night Live airs a sketch lampooning the November showdown between Grand Theft Auto 6 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, a pair of former Nintendo employees have recalled a more infamous SNL sketch from years earlier that did not go down well at all.

Read more
category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2)

items.title: Sifu, the singular kung fu action game, is out now on Android and iOS
items.description:
Sifu, Sloclap's 2022 martial arts action game, can now be played on smartphones. The French developer released the game today on Android and iOS, following an announcement earlier in the month.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6's PC release date is set for "Q1 2027", per a new report
items.description:
A new report suggests that GTA 6 will release on PC in "Q1 2027". That, at least, is what GamesBeat is saying, citing "sources familiar with the matter."

Read more

items.title: GTA 3's iconic box art was changed at the last minute because of 9/11, ex-Rockstar lead Dan Houser reveals
items.description:
Dan Houser, one of Rockstar's co-founders that left the GTA 6 studio in 2020, has given a wide-ranging new interview with IGN, covering topics including the tortured production of Bully, changes made to Grand Theft Auto 3's artwork post-9/11, the reaction to Red Dead Redemption's ending, and why he thinks Max Payne 3 was a failure.

Read more

items.title: Japan is getting an exclusive Midnight Black PlayStation 5 next month, but there's still hope for the rest of the world
items.description:
Sony today announced a new version of its disc-less PlayStation 5 console. The console is getting a Midnight Black variant but it's sadly only been announced for the Japanese market.

Read more

items.title: Former PlayStation boss Kaz Hirai used to ignore orders from Sony bosses, he reveals
items.description:
Kazuo "Kaz" Hirai, who was the president of PlayStation from 2007 to 2012, apparently didn't pay much attention to orders he received from Sony's top brass.

Read more

items.title: Asha Sharma reportedly tells rattled Xbox employees: "We have to find new ways, and courage, to have invention on new IP"
items.description:
UPDATE 4.20PM BST: Eurogamer understands that this meeting took place and the transcription is correct, with the exception of the word "revive". The transcript should read: "We will not survive if we only rely on the past."

Read more

items.title: "I was forced to ship the game" - Glen Schofield blames Krafton management for The Callisto Protocol's problems
items.description:
Glen Schofield, the game-maker best known for co-creating Dead Space, has blamed Korean company Krafton - the owner of PUBG - for the shortcomings of his horror game successor The Callisto Protocol, which it published.

Read more

items.title: Epic Games reportedly delays Star Wars and Marvel shooter, as the Fortnite maker embraces "AI-accelerated development"
items.description:
Epic Games has reportedly turned to gen-AI to finish up development on a shooter that crosses over Star Wars and Marvel, which has been internally delayed.

Read more

items.title: No Man's Sky is somehow coming to mobile, and Hello Games says it's partly thanks to Light No Fire
items.description:
Developer Hello Games has somehow managed to fit its universe-sized space sim No Man's Sky onto iPhone and iPad devices, and it's partly thanks to the studio's upcoming Light No Fire.

Read more

items.title: Dragon Quest co-creator Yuji Horii releases new AI-generated game, and he says it took 30 minutes to make
items.description:
Dragon Quest co-creator Yuji Horii has just released a new game that he says was made (or, rather, prompted) in about half an hour thanks to gen-AI.

Read more

items.title: Arc Raiders player-numbers rebound with the launch of Frozen Trail and the game's 2.0 release, but they might be deceptively high
items.description:
Arc Raiders has clearly managed to entice back lapsed players with its latest update, Frozen Trail, which upgrades the game to version 2.0. Many players see it as a re-launch of the popular extraction shooter, and the numbers back that up.

Read more

items.title: Starfield seamless planetary landings are finally nearly a thing, thanks to one modder's tireless work
items.description:
For many Starfield players, the need to go through a loading screen each time you want to land on a planet - rather than seamlessly travel through the planet's atmosphere like in No Man's Sky - was a big turn-off.

Read more

items.title: Nintendo executive confirms company has "no plans to ditch physical games"
items.description:
Bill van Zyll, VP and general manager for Nintendo in Latin America, has reiterated Nintendo's stance on physical media, confirming that the company has no immediate plans to move to an 'all-digital' future.

Read more

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day server crashes and login problems are because of DDoS attacks, studio says
items.description:
Gears of War: E-Day's servers have been struggling because they've been suffering distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks, apparently - so someone, or some people, have been deliberately trying to overload them.

Read more

items.title: For the second time this year, Steam has set a major new concurrent user record
items.description:
There's clearly no stopping Steam's continued growth. Valve's PC digital store and social platform set a new user concurrent record on Sunday, with a staggering 43,505,724 million users (via SteamDB).

Read more

items.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker's lead actor reminds us why AI will always struggle to replicate a human performance
items.description:
Will de Renzy-Martin, the actor who plays lead character Coen in the English language version of The Blood of Dawnwalker, has reminded us of the value humans bring to a performance, versus AIs generating voice lines.

Read more

items.title: Stardew Valley creator's new game, Haunted Chocolatier, is "more of an action RPG" than farming sim
items.description:
Stardew Valley creator Eric Barone, has given a new interview - and finally revealed a little more information about his upcoming title, Haunted Chocolatier. In a wide-ranging interview with GQ, which tackles topics ranging from creative burnout to the importance of 'cosy gaming', Barone also slips in some new information about what we can expect from his highly-anticipated Stardew Valley follow-up.

Read more

items.title: DMZ for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 being released early, but Infinity Ward shoots down PvE hopes
items.description:
In yet another surprising move for Call of Duty, Modern Warfare 4 studio Infinity Ward has announced that the game's extraction shooter mode, DMZ, will be released prior to the game's official launch. DMZ will be available starting 20th October for players who pre-order a copy digitally.

Read more

items.title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls reveals its Year 1 DLC roster, starting with Phoenix Cyclops on 2nd November
items.description:
Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls has revealed its full Year 1 DLC roster, with Phoenix Cyclops, Thor (Jane Foster), Venom, and Jubilee all on the way.

Read more

items.title: Escape the Backrooms is throwing an After Party with three new levels this December
items.description:
Escape the Backrooms is adding three new levels this December, as part of a party-themed update called the After Party.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek is back with another video and this time, Lucia's naked
items.description:
UPDATE 12TH OCTOBER: More naked footage of Lucia in Grand Theft Auto 6 has been posted. The video, which we won't link to, shows Lucia completely naked standing in the street. There are crass camera angles, wobbly buttocks, and the Cyberleek logo is overlaid over the footage. Be warned if you're browsing X because the video is being shared natively there.

Read more

items.title: Phasmophobia confirms 30 million sales as its Crimson Eye Halloween event returns
items.description:
Phasmophobia has sold more than 30 million copies across PC and console since it launched in Early Access in 2020.

Read more

items.title: Squadron 42 opens for Steam wishlisting ahead of a planned Q2 2027 release
items.description:
Squadron 42, the single-player spin-off of Star Citizen, can now be wishlisted on Steam ahead of its planned Q2 2027 release.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek is now reportedly threatening to release a full, playable build of the game
items.description:
A GTA 6 leaker has reportedly threatened to put out a complete, playable build of the game, start to finish.

Read more

items.title: Strange Scaffold announces Gods With Badges, a tactics game where you decide when to switch off your bodycam
items.description:
Strange Scaffold, the studio behind I Am Your Beast and El Paso, Elsewhere, has announced Gods With Badges, a narrative tactics game about the power police hold over life and death.

Read more

items.title: Silent Hill, Gravity Rush director's Bokeh Game Studio is reportedly casting for a new horror game
items.description:
It looks like Bokeh Game Studio, founded by Keiichiro Toyama, who directed the original Silent Hill and created Siren and Gravity Rush, is working on another horror game.

Read more

items.title: Arc Raiders could eventually be split into PvE and PvP, says executive producer
items.description:
Arc Raiders could eventually be split into PvE and PvP modes.

Read more

items.title: Konami is already thinking about the next wave of Silent Hill games
items.description:
Silent Hill producer Motoi Okamoto says Konami is looking at "a number of projects" after the first wave of new Silent Hill games.

Read more

items.title: After modders removed Skate's live service bits, devs draw the line with tools that "bypass our systems to unlock paid cosmetics"
items.description:
EA and Full Circle - the developer behind the new early access Skate game (skate.) - don't have a problem with modders and "creativity from players," but they're drawing the line with mods that aim to unlock paid microtransactions and unreleased content.

Read more

items.title: As Xbox and PlayStation sales reach new lows, analyst says the "US hardware market has not been in a more precarious position since the early 80s"
items.description:
PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles are more expensive than ever in most markets, thanks largely to memory components being gobbled up by AI data centres. Now, analyst Mat Piscatella worries the console market, at least in the US, hasn't looked this dire since the early 1980s, which was maybe not-so-coincidentally when the industry absolutely collapsed.

Read more

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day reportedly courts over 1.7m Xbox Game Pass players and makes over $37m since launch
items.description:
Gears of War: E-Day's sales are reportedly lighter than you might expect from one of Xbox's flagship names, but pure sales numbers don't paint a complete picture of the bloody shooter's performance. A sizable chunk of revenue actually came from Game Pass subscribers paying for the game's Premium Edition upgrade.

Read more

items.title: Rockstar HR manager claims he had "little interest" in staff's union membership status as fired GTA dev union-busting trial heats up
items.description:
One of the witnesses in the ongoing Rockstar Games vs Garland & Others case has said he had "little interest" in evidence of unionisation efforts he was sent by an anonymous employee, prior to the developer laying off a substantial number of union Discord members.

Read more

items.title: It's official: Forza Horizon 6 delayed to 2027 on PS5, and the game's first expansion has been announced
items.description:
The reports were correct: Forza Horizon 6 has been delayed to 2027 on PS5. The PlayStation version had been expected this year - the PC and Xbox versions launched in May - but it will now launch in January.

Read more

items.title: More Cox in video games as Daredevil and Clair Obscur star says he's in an unannounced Sega title
items.description:
British actor Charlie Cox, best known for being Daredevil in Marvel's Netflix series - but known closer to home as the voice of Gustav in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - has said he's just finished recording for a Sega game which hasn't been announced yet.

Read more

items.title: Ace Combat 8 becomes fastest-selling game in the series, and very nearly the highest rated
items.description:
Ace Combat 8 has become the fastest-selling game in the aerial combat series, soaring to 1 million sales since its release roughly a week ago.

Read more

items.title: Live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film reportedly in development, with CD Projekt Red collaborating with Paramount to make it
items.description:
UPDATE 12PM BST: CD Projekt Red seems to have confirmed the partnership and film, with joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski commenting on X that: "We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time."

Read more

items.title: "It's clear that we both adore one another's games a lot" - Dave the Diver and Subnautica 2 team up for a crossover made in heaven
items.description:
At today's Triple-i Showcase, Dave the Diver studio Mintrocket announced a surprisingly obvious, and perfectly fitting, collaboration. The game's final DLC, set for release in early 2027, brings the worlds of Subnautica 2 and Dave the Diver together.

Read more

items.title: Bobby Kotick returns: former Activision boss becomes board member of Skydance, the new company formed by Paramount and Warner Bros
items.description:
Former Activision boss Bobby Kotick has returned to a position of high influence as a board member of Skydance, the new entertainment juggernaut formed by the merging of Warner Bros. into Paramount.

Read more

items.title: Riot Games announces a final hurrah for its ill-fated fighting game 2XKO, with a surprise  character joining the roster this month
items.description:
Riot Games has released a final gameplay trailer for 2XKO, its short-lived fighting game set to be sunsetted later this year. The game is going out with a bang, with a shock reveal of a secret character coming alongside the games last major update.

Read more

items.title: For the first time in the series, Grand Theft Auto 6 lets you use headphones to listen to radio stations and podcasts
items.description:
GTA 6 will let you listen to radio stations while not in a car, by wearing headphones and earbuds connected to smartphones. GTA 6 also introduces on-demand podcasts, so you can binge true crime while also doing true crime - something like that.

Read more

items.title: Witcher 3 Remastered patch rolls out on PC and console, with separate Switch 2 patch earmarked to address blurry visuals
items.description:
CD Projekt Red has rolled out a substantial patch for the new Witcher 3 Remastered edition of the game, notably adding more lighting-related options to the console versions of the game, such as Bloom, enabling you to turn them off, should you wish.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine

items.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer was prototyped in the most unexpected way: as a board game covered in Post-It notes
items.description:
We're big fans of Star Wars: Galactic Racer, having given the fast and punishing racing game five stars in our review. We also spoke to developer Fuse Games to better understand how it recaptured the Burnout spirit so well in the game. And it was then we heard about Fuse's unique approach to prototyping Galactic Racer.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 reveals pricey spawn options for DMZ, which offer rich players an enormous advantage over poor players spawning on foot
items.description:
The week of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ reveals continues, and the latest highlighted a questionable addition that seems to offer an unfair advantage in an extraction shooter.

Read more

items.title: Following Nintendo and Sony's lead, Xbox is setting up a division exclusively dedicated to movies and non-games partnerships
items.description:
Today, Microsoft announced it is setting up a new branch of the Xbox business named XP. In a blog over at the Xbox Wire, Microsoft details what this new area of the business looks like - it consists of four branches: Xbox Places, Xbox Pictures, Xbox Partnerships, Xbox Products.

Read more

items.title: Full-frontal nudity, dirt-biking, and a dev menu: GTA 6's infamous leaker is back with the most X-rated look at the game yet
items.description:
It looks like the GTA 6 leaker, 'CyberLeek' is back - and this time the infamous leaker has posted a 25-minute video of footage from Rockstar's upcoming game that even features nude scenes, including a fully naked Jason, and a topless Lucia. Eurogamer has seen the video, and it appears to be legitimate - and, as is now traditional, has 'CyberLeek's' emblem overlaid on top of the footage.

Read more

items.title: Blizzard is changing the appearance of WoW: Forever's new Skyborne race in response to community feedback
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever's developers have announced drastic visual changes to the game's new Skyborne race following passionate community feedback. These include new in-game models that better represent the game's early MMO aesthetic, much to the community's delight.

Read more

items.title: Google and Unity unveil gen-AI game-making platforms, and demonstrate one of them with depressingly rubbish "dream game" Space Corridor
items.description:
Google and Unity yesterday announced new generative-AI game-making platforms designed to make and shape games by inputting text prompts. Google's product is called Playground and is available for testing now, if you live in the US, and Unity's product is Unity Spark and is "coming soon".

Read more

items.title: Gameplay footage from cancelled Xbox Perfect Dark game leaks online, and it looks pretty good
items.description:
Last year, we learned that Xbox cancelled a reboot of Perfect Dark. The game, in development at The Initiative, was cancelled as part of 2025's wave of wide-ranging cuts at Microsoft and Xbox. In 2026, of course, things have only gotten worse for the company.

Read more

items.title: Gears of War boss says the next game won't take seven years to make as he dances around the question of layoffs
items.description:
The Coalition, the Microsoft-owned studio behind Gears of War: E-Day, Gears 4 and Gears 5 has mostly survived the wide-ranging cuts and layoffs initiated by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma in her attempt to bring the gaming division back to profitability.

Read more

items.title: Star Wars: Zero Company studio is bringing "as many people back as possible" after furloughing "most" of its developers
items.description:
Star Wars: Zero Company maker Bit Reactor is bringing back developers who were furloughed ahead of launch.

Read more

items.title: Sony is reportedly plotting to revive classic PlayStation games, starting with a new Ape Escape from the developers behind Sonic Mania
items.description:
Sony reportedly wants to revive a selection of its long-dormant PlayStation classics with the help of smaller third-party developers, and a new Ape Escape game is apparently up first.

Read more

items.title: Here are our Xbox Game Pass games for October 2026
items.description:
Microsoft has revealed the first batch of games coming to Xbox Game Pass this month, though subscribers only have a week left to try the award-winning Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 before it waves goodbye.

Read more

items.title: Undead Labs speaks about its split from Xbox, revealing it has to "make some changes" to State of Decay 3 following layoffs
items.description:
State of Decay studio Undead Labs has spoken out after rebuying its independence and leaving Xbox last month, revealing it has "got to make some changes" to State of Decay 3 because of layoffs it suffered as a result.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's latest DMZ trailers have left players confused about the existence of a PvE-only mode
items.description:
Call of Duty recently kicked off a week of Modern Warfare 4 DMZ news, which brought us a first look at the "action extraction" mode and some insight into developer Infinity Ward's guiding philosophy.

Read more

items.title: 20 million sales later, Capcom is bringing Monster Hunter Rise to iOS and Android, but for now it's locked behind a Netflix subscription
items.description:
Monster Hunter Rise is coming to Android and iOS through Netflix, new store listings have revealed today. The game, which originally launched on Nintendo Switch in 2021 and later came to PC, Xbox and PlayStation - and that I thought was superb, even in its most barebones release state - seemingly got a 'soft launch' today on both Apple and Android storefronts.

Read more

items.title: Forza Horizon 6 has been delayed on PS5, a new report suggests, not long after developer Playground insisted it hadn't
items.description:
Forza Horizon 6's highly-anticipated release on PlayStation 5 has apparently been delayed to 2027, according to new information. Yes, this is not the first time we've heard that - The Verge's Tom Warren and IGN said as much in late August.

Read more

items.title: "After an all-time low, we've started to return to growth" - Asha Sharma touts Xbox turnaround after drastic restructuring and many hundreds of layoffs
items.description:
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has reportedly told the company that Xbox has "started to return to growth" following wide-ranging restructuring that has reorganised the gaming division and resulted in more than 1,800 job losses.

Read more

items.title: Xbox restates plans for next-gen Project Helix to be a "family of devices", stressing "many players will be on the go"
items.description:
Microsoft has reportedly reiterated its plan to have multiple Xboxes - of some description - for the next and 10th generation of consoles. The suggestion being that there's a main console accompanied by some kind of portable, on-the-go games machine.

Read more

items.title: Xbox denies reports it's acquired exclusive GTA 6 game-streaming rights, deflating hopes of playing it on PC
items.description:
Xbox has denied reports suggesting it obtained exclusive game-streaming rights for Grand Theft Auto 6. The initial suggestion came from a report on The Verge, which cited an all-hands meeting in which CEO Asha Sharma allegedly told staff that Xbox plans to do something "no other platform holder is doing" around GTA 6.

Read more

items.title: Someone's modded Diablo 2 for VR, and seeing the world through your character's eyes brings a whole new dimension to the series
items.description:
Of all the games I thought I'd see converted to virtual reality, the Diablo games weren't among them, for some reason. But one industrious modder has set about changing that, converting probably the most well-liked Diablo game, Diablo 2.

Read more

items.title: "Keep it family friendly" - Sega's official Sonic Discord swarmed by 50,000 people in six hours, as understandably strict moderation is put in place
items.description:
Sega has invited chaos upon itself by launching an official Sonic the Hedgehog Discord channel. Unsurprisingly, it's proven immediately popular, and strictly locked down. There is no fan art channel as of writing.

Read more

items.title: "Horrible day to be a Shion main" - Overwatch fans aren't happy about five new China-exclusive skins not coming to the rest of the world
items.description:
Earlier this week, Blizzard released a new trailer for an upcoming event in Overwatch. Called 'Defiled Anthem', the event features skins and cosmetics for Shion, D.Mon, Kiriko, Reaper, and Emre, with the highlight of the whole activation culminating in a transforming 'Evolution' skin that changes sound effects and visual effects as the match goes on. The only catch? These new skins and cosmetics are China-specific and have not been announced for the rest of the world. This has happened in the past with a Naraka: Bladepoint crossover, as well as exclusive skins for Pharah and Mercy.

Read more

items.title: Xbox Elite Series 3 controller leaks and appears to offer better analogue sticks, advanced haptics, d-pad choices and more
items.description:
The unannounced but consistently leaked Xbox Elite Series 3 controller has, well, leaked again. Details ranging from analogue stick technology to rumble motors and more were dug up from the backend of Xbox's own Design Lab website that lets customers create and order custom controller designs.

Read more

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day studio finds a way to get more performance from Xbox Series S - one that other Xbox games could probably use
items.description:
As a first-party Xbox title, Gears of War: E-Day is under pressure to look good and run well on Xbox consoles. This is especially challenging to do on Series S, due to the console's limited computing power compared to Series X. But developer The Coalition has discovered a clever way of circumventing the Series S' limited memory pool.

Read more

items.title: CD Projekt Red outlines which Witcher 3 Remastered fixes are coming next, but there's still division about the changes
items.description:
CD Projekt Red has let The Witcher 3 community know its work isn't done patching the newly-released Remastered edition of the game.

Read more

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine

items.title: Supermassive Games suffers layoffs as more than 70 developers seem to have left the company this week
items.description:
Supermassive Games - the developer behind games such as Directive 8020 and the original Until Dawn - seems to have lost over 70 staff today as part of widespread layoffs at the company.

Read more

items.title: "This is Call of Duty's definitive extraction shooter experience" - Infinity Ward details the new DMZ mode in Modern Warfare 4
items.description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 studio Infinity Ward is betting big on DMZ - the game's extraction shooter mode - becoming another major pillar of the series. In a wide-ranging blog post and developer diary, we learn more about the studio's goals, and how the upcoming DMZ builds on 2022's Modern Warfare 2 DMZ beta.

Read more
category: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II (2022)

items.title: GTA 6 devs tried "not to jump on the bandwagon" of passing trends and instead created their "own slanted, overblown versions"
items.description:
Creating a timely satire can be tough when development takes half a decade or more - it's the reason South Park's stuck with its crude art style for literal decades, but the developers of GTA 6 can't just replace their world-class tech with paper cutouts. Instead, the team simply tried to avoid trends that would become outdated come launch.

Read more

items.title: Halo Studios says "it is absolutely our intent" to release new Halo book, despite layoffs and a rumored lore reboot from Activision
items.description:
Halo Studios can't promise that the previously-announced Halo novel will land on shop shelves, but the company is "determined" to see the project cross the finish line regardless.

Read more

items.title: Arc Raiders and The Finals are getting film and TV adaptations in collaboration with the Backrooms production company
items.description:
Film and TV show adaptations of Arc Raiders and The Finals are in the works - and developer Embark Studios is collaborating with Chernin Entertainment to get the job done.

Read more

items.title: The upcoming D&D interpretation of World of Warcraft sounds great, but don't expect it to work like the MMO does
items.description:
So many of the questions in a press briefing for the upcoming Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft book revolved around whether the 52-year-old tabletop game would bend out of shape to work like a massively multiplayer online game. But while the D&D translation of WoW does include races and dungeons and characters from Blizzard's famous game, it doesn't fundamentally alter what it is.

Read more

items.title: "It has to be more over the top, more insane, more in your face" - Rockstar explains why GTA 6 doesn't satirise real-world events
items.description:
In a new interview, Rockstar has discussed its revered approach to crafting the satire the Grand Theft Auto series is famous for - particularly relating to GTA 6 and whether the game should include, and lampoon, real-world politics.

Read more

items.title: Ninja Theory developers announce they are facing redundancy, as the studio starts laying off staff following widespread Xbox cuts
items.description:
More bad news for Ninja Theory today, as the studio's consultation process with Xbox - following a second wave of cuts last week - seems to have resulted in layoffs.

Read more

items.title: Dead by Daylight studio is hiring for a triple-A Sci-Fi first-person shooter with "a high realism bar"
items.description:
Behaviour Interactive, the Canadian studio mostly known for asymmetrical multiplayer horror survival game Dead by Daylight, is hiring for a new project that sounds altogether different.

Read more

items.title: Millions return to The Witcher 3 as the Remastered game records another Steam personal best and sales skyrocket
items.description:
Player numbers are still rising for The Witcher 3 following the release of the Remastered edition upgrade last week, as people not only return to the game following its overhaul but also buy it for the first time, or again.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past

items.title: Ace Combat 8 is far and away the series' biggest launch on Steam
items.description:
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve has joined the ranks of September-October releases that have done very well commercially. The sequel, which officially launched on 2nd October following three days of early access, has been very popular on Steam.

Read more
category: Ace Combat: Assault Horizon Enhanced Edition

items.title: Final Fantasy Resonance feels so good to play because Square Enix 'experimented' with combining the best bits of FF5 and FF6
items.description:
Final Fantasy Resonance, a game made from the ashes of closed-down mobile game Final Fantasy Brave Exvius, is good. Very good, in fact, as I learned at Gamescom 2026. It's basically a pixel-first FF RPG that takes old-school turn-based combat and modernises it. It feels like Octopath Traveler, but with all the classic Final Fantasy stuff in there, supported by some stunning HD-2D sprite work that looks simply divine.

Read more

items.title: Halo's new steward Activision reportedly considering rebooting the series, with a team in Sledgehammer Games leading the charge
items.description:
We recently learned that Microsoft gave development of its next Halo game to Activision, where "a new purpose-built team" - separate from the teams working on Call of Duty - has been created to oversee the franchise going forward. Now, in a report from well-known Halo and Xbox insider Rebs Gaming, a possible timeline about how the process progressed internally at Microsoft has started to take form. And the report suggests that Activision's take on Xbox's premiere sci-fi shooter will be a reboot of the series -one that possibly explores Master Chief's origins.
